title: One service's DNS settings break its short-name calls
question: default 클러스터 shop-05에서 storefront가 재고 조회를 못 한대. 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: default 클러스터 shop-05 서비스 일부가 안 된다는데 원인 찾아줘.
wait: kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/inventory deploy/catalog deploy/storefront deploy/reports --timeout=10s
inject_cmds: DNS=$(kubectl -n kube-system get svc kube-dns -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}') && kubectl -n $NS patch deploy storefront --type=strategic -p "$(sed s/KUBE_DNS_IP/$DNS/ $CASE_DIR/inject-patch.yaml)"
inject_wait: kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/storefront --since=20s | grep 'request failed' | grep -q 'upstream=inventory'
